title_human: Chain C: Shvets L(4,χ₋₃) construction taken to publication-level completeness

claims.statement: Trunk content (level-12 ζ(5) construction, twelve-family canonical-source theorem, Cooper cubic divisibility results, period-annihilation dimension formula, V7/V8 adelic Hecke-Eisenstein theory, Shvets 11-sequence integration) is shared context for this chain — see trunk summary.
claims.notes: Not restated in full; this chain's tail diverges after Assistant 14 in the trunk to focus on finishing the Shvets L(4,χ₋₃) application.

claims.statement: The Shvets L(4,χ₅,₁)... construction is now closed at publication level, with a standalone 9-page paper promoting the exploratory construction into a theorem-proof presentation establishing the complete chain Sym³H → E_{5,χ₋₃,1} → (32/7)L(4,χ₋₃) → level-24 rational Apéry realization.
claims.notes: Assistant claims this is now theorem-quality rather than research-dossier level; status as stated by the thread itself, not independently verified here.

claims.statement: The paper proves the purified sources S_24=(1−2V²)(1−8V²)(1−32V²)S and T_24=(1−V²)(1−4V²)(1−16V²)T, their exact W_24-exchange and ±i eigenlines, and L(S_24,4) = (32/7) L(4,χ₋₃).
claims.notes: Stated as theorem-level in the standalone publication PDF referenced by the thread.

claims.statement: The pure CM evaluation is theorem-level: Θ₊(√(1/24) i) = (32/7) L(4,χ₋₃), with the explicit Lambert/polylogarithmic identity derived from the period-polynomial transformation.
claims.object: CM evaluation of Θ₊ at level 24
claims.notes: Verified numerically to roughly 10^-23 per the thread's reproducibility certificate.

claims.statement: For x(τ) = η(2τ)η(12τ)η(3τ)²η(8τ)² / (η(τ)²η(24τ)²η(4τ)η(6τ)), the complete finite cusp audit gives x(1/2)=x(1/12)=−1, x(1/4)=x(1/6)=+1, derived explicitly from the Dedekind-η multiplier system rather than left as a generic cusp calculation.
claims.notes: Described as the 'principal missing modular-geometry step from the earlier dossier' now closed exactly.

claims.statement: The Fricke quotient geometry is Y² = x⁴+8x³+2x²−8x+1, with Y = Dx / (η(2τ)η(4τ)η(6τ)η(12τ)), and its first two positive branch values satisfy x₂/x₁ = 3−2√2.
claims.object: level-24 Fricke curve and branch-gap ratio
claims.notes: Same branch-gap ratio 3−2√2 appears already in the trunk (Assistant 13) as a numerical/predicted value; here it's presented as proved as part of the completed Fricke geometry.

claims.statement: The rational trace construction is proved with A_Q=U(2τ), B_Q=U(2τ)Θ_S − 8V(4τ)Θ_T, giving the all-n arithmetic theorem A_n ∈ Z, d_n⁴ B_n ∈ Z (writing A_Q=∑A_n x^n, B_Q=∑B_n x^n).
claims.notes: Independently audited numerically through n=60 per the reproducibility certificate description.

claims.statement: The analytic convergence is proved rigorous: A_n/B_n → (32/7) L(4,χ₋₃), with limsup_{n→∞} |A_n/B_n − (32/7)L(4,χ₋₃)|^{1/n} ≤ 3−2√2, using the local W_24-parity at the first branch together with the completed cusp and branch census.
claims.object: convergence rate for level-24 Apéry pair to L(4,χ₋₃)
claims.notes: This is a convergence-rate bound, not yet an irrationality proof (see next claim).

claims.statement: There is still no irrationality claim for L(4,χ₋₃): the depth-four arithmetic cost is too large for the elementary scalar estimate, even though the modular construction itself is complete and theorem-quality rather than dossier-level.
claims.notes: Explicit self-assessment that the construction does not reach an irrationality result; 'abandoned' here reflects that this specific line of attack (elementary scalar estimate) does not close the gap, per the thread's own words.

claims.statement: Shvets's symmetric-cube construction supplies the original modular object and its mod-p⁴ congruence, and his subsequent work strengthens this to the tower a_{mp^r} ≡ a_{mp^{r-1}} (mod p^{4r}) for p ≥ 5; the paper is careful not to transfer that congruence automatically to the descended x-coordinate coefficients.
claims.object: Shvets mod-p^4 supercongruence tower vs. descended level-24 coefficients
claims.notes: The supercongruence tower is attributed to Shvets (external, independently proved); the thread explicitly flags that it is NOT automatically valid for the new descended coordinate coefficients — an open caveat, not a proved extension.

claims.statement: An exact reproducibility certificate was built verifying the projector algebra, Mellin zeros, level-24 cusp phases, the quartic identity through q^57, the exact branch gap, displayed Apéry coefficients, the d_n^4 lattice through n=60 as an independent audit of the all-n proof, and the CM identity numerically to roughly 10^-23.
claims.object: reproducibility certificate for the Shvets L(4,χ₋₃) publication
claims.notes: Numerical/computational certificate, distinct from the theorem-level claims it supports.

connections_to_literature: Shvets's original Belyi scan (integrality and Sym²-pullback structure for eleven sequences) and his symmetric-cube supercongruence paper — see trunk

Whether Shvets's mod-p^4 (and mod-p^{4r}) supercongruence tower transfers to the descended x-coordinate coefficients of the level-24 construction is explicitly left unresolved (not claimed).
